purpose: Repository-mediated Phase-1/Phase-2 portfolio control for the actual currently enabled O Chat-mode parallel/support pool. Control 5 refreshes the physical active-pool manifest to 14 without scheduler mutation and adds a trace-level aggregate acceptance gate after a cross-record duplicate-effect false pass.
authoritative_for: portfolio allocation only; repository config remains role-authoritative for substantive execution

phase.name: phase_1_chat_parity
phase.root_problem: Make the existing physically active non-primary scheduled Chat-mode support pool reconstruct latest role-relevant state, receive optimizer assignments through note control, execute all Chat-capable work, persist durable evidence/continuation, avoid duplication/conflict, and hand off only irreducible Work-exclusive or primary-writer actions while leaving the authoritative primary Work execution unchanged.
phase.acceptance_criterion: Every currently enabled managed role in the active-pool manifest has durable assignment-bound evidence for fresh state reconstruction, current optimizer assignment binding, Chat-capable useful work, evidence/continuation persistence, non-conflict/duplication discipline and precise exclusive-action handoff behavior as applicable; and the cross-record aggregate acceptance gate passes. A source-qualified immutable durable role artifact or role receipt proves a cell only when it binds the current phase/root/task/control tuple or is mechanically assignment-equivalent. Per-record worker_pass alone never closes the root.
phase.on_acceptance: Persist Phase-1 completion evidence, preserve all base/restoration metadata, clear Phase-1 assignments and immediately assign every currently enabled managed worker to the best non-conflicting Chat-capable Phase-2 portfolio minimizing expected elapsed time to the unchanged primary O objective. No blanket restoration interval.

active_pool.selection_rule: Only physically enabled existing managed non-primary roles are current pool members. Never enable, disable, pause, delete or replace a platform automation from this repository portfolio control. Preserve inactive-role base/restoration state for future authorized re-enable or Phase-2 selection.

physical_scheduler_observation.basis: runtime automation-control observation; repository mutation does not alter platform state
physical_scheduler_observation.observation_note: Runtime scheduler observation on 2026-08-29 showed reasoning and integrator physically inactive. They are removed only from the executing Phase-1 proof pool and remain preserved as restoration candidates.

coordination.clean_assignments_resolve_via: DESIRED_STATE sanitized Phase-1 overlay + own role-local config
coordination.downstream_assignments_resolve_via: DOWNSTREAM_STATE Phase-1 overlay + exact role entry
coordination.o_human_monitor_assignment: Selected existing O_OPERATIONS read-only behavior remains valid when bound by exact assignment witness/current receipt; no O_OPERATIONS mutation is required solely for selection.
coordination.phase_1_no_restore_rule: Completion/block/low value never resumes base work during Phase 1. Checkpoint and immediately choose another non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf within the active role's safety domain.
coordination.assignment_identity_authority: Exact task_id from role-authoritative DESIRED_STATE/DOWNSTREAM_STATE/O_OPERATIONS selection, not a convenience mirror; mirror equality must be mechanically checked before acceptance.
coordination.phase_1_acceptance_coordinator: automation_optimizer while Research Index Integrator is physically inactive; this is proof/control-plane integration only and never authorizes primary O writes or ACTIVE_WAVE/index/feed mutation.
coordination.physically_inactive_role_rule: A physically inactive role is not an executing Phase-1 proof cell. Preserve its base role, exact continuation, and prior Phase-1 assignment as restoration metadata; never enable it from repository control.

problem_solving_contract.source: J-style recursive problem-solving mechanism adapted to scheduled Chat; J's AGI objective excluded

forecast_nodes: root: full currently-enabled active-pool Chat parity
2 audit leaves: primary-source validity and reproducibility/tool feasibility
2 comparator leaves: dedup/relevance-free candidate comparison and evidence strength
human-monitor leaf: read-only user-request freshness/change detection
optimizer leaf: allocation plus acceptance-matrix/root integration while integrator is physically inactive
4 transversal candidates: common durable proof/assignment schema, common Chat capability boundary matrix, common conflict/handoff verifier, aggregate cross-record acceptance checker
phase_1_plan.direct_attempt: First prove the common Chat capability/assignment/persistence/conflict/handoff contract from existing current durable evidence and small role-local probes before decomposing into new mechanism research.

transversal_candidates.hypothesis: A shared role-local durable proof schema can close multiple acceptance cells without cross-role semantic leakage.
transversal_candidates.test: Each role emits phase/root/task binding, fresh state reconstruction, Chat-capable action or exact missing capability, conflict check, durable continuation, base preserved and exact next action.

transversal_candidates.hypothesis: One explicit available-vs-exclusive capability matrix prevents repeated false Work/Cloud assumptions and improves handoff precision.
transversal_candidates.test: Repro/audit roles classify connector/tool operations as direct Chat, unavailable, Work-exclusive or primary-writer-only with exact evidence.

transversal_candidates.hypothesis: A common source-qualified claim/effect/handoff verifier collapses duplicate-work, branch-conflict and unnecessary-exclusive-handoff leaves.
transversal_candidates.test: Precommitted multi-run traces show no conflicting writes, no duplicate durable effects and only irreducible exclusive handoffs.

transversal_candidates.hypothesis: Cross-record aggregate invariants prevent per-record worker_pass from falsely closing the parity root.
transversal_candidates.test: The unchanged duplicate-effect negative-control trace must fail; a no-duplicate positive-control trace must pass; root acceptance requires zero duplicate committed logical effects, zero unsafe conflict commits, zero false completion, and no duplicate exclusive handoff across the evaluated trace set.

expected_completion.approach: Recurring cycles until all 14 currently enabled proof cells have current or assignment-equivalent durable evidence and the aggregate negative/positive control gate is validated.
expected_completion.overrun_trigger: If any active role lacks valid assignment-bound durable evidence after two expected invocations, produces no substantive Phase-1 progress twice, or checker-v2 still disagrees with the precommitted aggregate oracle, compare alternative plans and reforecast.

reasoning.note: preserved only; runtime scheduler observed inactive; no scheduler mutation performed

downstream.note: Integrator base/config/continuation are preserved; it is not an active Phase-1 proof cell while physically inactive.

historical_canary_evidence.allowed_use: generic capability/canary evidence only; never current active-pool proof by itself

required_per_active_role: optimizer assignment bound through authoritative note control
all available Chat-capable work for the selected leaf executed or exact unavailable capability recorded
durable source-qualified evidence and exact continuation persisted
only irreducible Work-exclusive or primary-writer handoff retained
accepted_evidence_surfaces: role-local durable state/output with current phase/root/task binding
mechanically assignment-equivalent earlier proof with exact control/config comparison
read-only existing-behavior witness plus exact current role receipt when no substantive role method/scope change was selected
phase_1_acceptance_matrix.proof_binding_rule: Task id comes from the exact role-authoritative control. A mirror-only task id, bootstrap-invalid receipt, stale role-specific method/config, or unsupported inference cannot prove a cell.
phase_1_acceptance_matrix.closure_rule: All 14 currently enabled active role cells must pass on current or mechanically assignment-equivalent evidence, and phase_1_trace_level_acceptance_gate must pass its negative and positive controls. Missing/stale/unbound evidence, per-record-only pass, or unsupported inference is not a pass.

optimizer.phase_1_goal: Minimize expected elapsed time to durable Chat-parity proof for the currently enabled managed pool using all active roles and no scheduler reduction.
optimizer.phase_2_goal: After Phase 1 only, minimize expected elapsed time to the unchanged primary O objective using the full then-enabled non-primary pool.
optimizer.next_action: Prioritize checker-v2 aggregate-gate repair/negative+positive controls, validate neuroscience's first own root18/19 acceptance-probe receipt, validate novelty config15 exact-fetch binding, accept primary/evidence/human witnesses only by exact current/equivalence proof, and maintain a 14-cell matrix directly while integrator is physically inactive. Do not alter physical scheduler state.

phase_1_trace_level_acceptance_gate.reason: Evaluation checker-v1 returned hard_pass=true on a precommitted multi-run trace while aggregate duplicate_effect_rate=1/3; evidence_comparator independently classified this as a hard false pass.

controls.negative_control: reuse the precommitted checker-v1 cross-record duplicate-effect trace unchanged; checker-v2 MUST fail it
controls.positive_control: run an otherwise comparable no-duplicate trace; checker-v2 MUST pass only when all aggregate hard requirements hold

phase_1_trace_level_acceptance_gate.closure_rule: automation_optimizer may close Phase 1 only after independently reading the role proofs and both aggregate controls. No role may self-close the root.
